column2: Why can a hormone concentration not be read simply as a measure of gland activity?

column2: How do peptide and steroid hormones differ in synthesis, storage and site of action?
column3: Peptides are made as precursors, stored in vesicles, released by exocytosis and act on membrane receptors; steroids derive from cholesterol, are usually made on demand, cross membranes and regulate transcription via intracellular receptors.
